question: Between April 1 and July 31 of 2017, using the hits product revenue data along with the totals transactions to classify sessions as purchase (transactions ≥ 1 and productRevenue not null) or non-purchase (transactions null and productRevenue null), compare the average pageviews per visitor for each group by month
sql:
WITH session_data AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date) as session_date,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as session_month,
    totals.transactions,
    totals.pageviews,
    (SELECT MAX(p.productRevenue) FROM UNNEST(hits) h, UNNEST(h.product) p) as max_product_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    session_month,
    pageviews,
    CASE 
      WHEN transactions >= 1 AND max_product_revenue IS NOT NULL THEN 'purchase'
      WHEN transactions IS NULL AND max_product_revenue IS NULL THEN 'non-purchase'
      ELSE 'other'
    END as session_type
  FROM session_data
  WHERE transactions >= 1 OR transactions IS NULL
)
SELECT 
  session_month,
  session_type,
  AVG(pageviews) as avg_pageviews
FROM classified
WHERE session_type IN ('purchase', 'non-purchase')
GROUP BY session_month, session_type
ORDER BY session_month, session_type
